messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected on prod-ingress (ingress-gw-*) — 5xx spike and TLS handshake anomalies reported. Severity: P1. Links: https://dash.redwood.example/alerts/2469990001 :rotating_light:

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): acked. I'm on it. pulling dashboards now — which region first?

Maya (infra): eu-west-1 and us-east-1 showing the worst error rates. latency also up for small payloads.

Priya (ingress): seeing a flood of 526/525 (gateway/ssl) from our edge proxies. tls logs show "PEM parse error" and "invalid private key" on several nodes.

Tom (network): any recent cert rotates pushed?

Priya (ingress): we did a manual cert bundle upload to the rotator 18m ago for a customer-managed leaf. rotator job shows success but the uploaded file size looks odd (smaller).

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): ok do we have stack traces or broken PEM content in the logs? paste a sample please.

Priya (ingress): logs: ```
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z ingress-gw-03 tls: PEM_parse: unexpected EOF
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z ingress-gw-03 handshake: failed to load certificate: ssl: PEM_read_bio_privatekey failed
2026-03-15T12:04:03Z proxy: upstream: 526 SSL_HANDSHAKE_ERROR
```

Maya (infra): checking S3 object for the bundle now. object: s3://cert-rotations/prod/customer-acme/2026-03-15-1200.pem. getting sha and head.

Maya (infra): sha mismatch vs last known good. file size 1.2KB (expected ~5.2KB). Looks truncated. md5: a1b2... vs previous 9f8e...

Carla (support): any customer visible impact? Support queue just got 8 tickets in last 10m about 502/5xx errors when calling API.

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): estimate traffic impacted ~12% of global requests, primarily eu-west and us-east edges. SLO alarm firing. Rolling mitigation: 1) block rotator uploads, 2) rollback to last-good cert on edge pool, 3) steer traffic off failing nodes.

Priya (ingress): I can push a rollback to the previous cert bundle to affected nodes. doing a dry-run on one node: ```
# on ingress-gw-03
sudo cp /etc/ingress/certs/backup/2026-03-10.pem /etc/ingress/certs/active.pem
sudo systemctl restart ingress-proxy
journalctl -u ingress-proxy -n 200 | tail -n 50
```

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): run it on a canary node then watch error rates. Maya, can you temporarily disable new uploads in the rotator API and mark the rotation job failing?

Maya (infra): rotator API: ```
curl -X POST https://rotator.internal/api/v1/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ROTATOR_TOKEN}"
# patched rotator to reject uploads
``` done. rotator now returns 409 for new uploads.

Priya (ingress): applied rollback to ingress-gw-03. monitoring...

Priya (ingress): quick check: backend health ok, TLS handshakes successful for that node now. 5xx for that node dropped from 18% -> 0.7%.

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): good. start rolling to the rest of the affected pool in batches of 5 with 30s spacing. update runbook tag: ingress-cert-failure -> step 3 (rollback leaf cert).

Tom (network): I'm creating a traffic steering entry to divert ~30% of eu-west traffic to the warm pool while we finish rollback. doing via traffic-controller.

Carla (support): posting status to customers: "We are aware of elevated 5xx errors affecting API calls in EU and US regions. Engineers are actively rolling back a recently uploaded certificate bundle and traffic is being rerouted to healthy nodes. ETA 30-45 mins for mitigation. We will update shortly."

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): nice. also create an incident slack channel for postmortem. I'll tag PM and Security after mitigation.

Priya (ingress): continuing rollout. executed on nodes: ingress-gw-03, -07, -08, -14. failures: none.

Maya (infra): rotator audit shows upload for that customer had a truncated multipart part — looks like a transmission error from the uploader service (uploader-v2). I've revoked current upload tokens for that customer and flagged their recent uploads. Investigating root cause with uploader team.

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): provisional timeline: t+0:00 alert, t+0:06 identify truncated cert, t+0:12 rollback canary, t+0:22 rollback pool, t+0:30 traffic steering, t+0:40 error rates back to baseline in most regions.

Carla (support): support message updated: adding note about customer-managed cert upload issue and asking affected customers to re-upload.

pm-ops: are any customers likely to have persistent sessions broken after rollback?

Priya (ingress): client TLS sessions should renegotiate but we don't expect long-lived user sessions to break. API consumer clients might need to retry once. No key material was exposed.

Maya (infra): locking down uploader-v2: rolling restart v2 with added integrity check. ```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/uploader-v2 -n platform
# add sha256 checksum validation for uploads
```

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): good. start collecting evidence for postmortem: rotator logs, uploader logs, cert file checksums, timeline. assign action items.

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): action items: [Priya] ensure all ingress nodes use last-good cert and verify checksums; [Maya] patch uploader to reject truncated uploads and add checksum validation; [Tom] validate traffic-steering rules removed after stabilization; [Carla] send follow-up to customers and coordinate any re-uploads; [pm-ops] draft customer communication.

Priya (ingress): checksums verified on all active nodes. pushing a global cache invalidation for old truncated files.

Maya (infra): uploader patch merged and deployed, rotator re-enabled but now rejects uploads without valid checksum header (x-upload-checksum).

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): monitoring: overall 5xx down to baseline ~0.4%. still watching for edge cases.

Carla (support): queue rate back to normal. closing immediate customer impact loop.

pm-ops: assigning postmortem owner?

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with infra and ingress. tagging security for any sensitivity review.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated — status changed to MONITORING by SRE-Oncall (Kartik).

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): handoff in 60m to next oncall (Priya-Ops) — leaving runbook notes and commands executed. summary for handoff: root cause: truncated cert bundle uploaded by uploader-v2 -> ingress failed to parse PEM -> TLS handshake failures -> 5xx surge. mitigation: rotator uploads disabled, rollback to previous certs on ingress pool, traffic steering to warm pool, uploader patched with checksum validation.

Priya (ingress): taking oncall in 60. I've documented exact commands, backup paths, and verification steps in the runbook.

Tom (network): I'll validate removal of temporary traffic steering at T+90m unless any regression appears.

Carla (support): final customer note queued. recommending customers re-upload if they see issues. tagging affected customer contacts.

SRE-Oncall (Kartik): closing thread for now — will follow up with full postmortem and RCA link: https://pm.redwood.example/incidents/2469990001-rca (ETA 48 hours).

Priya (ingress): thanks team. :handshake: 

Carla (support): nice work everyone. :thumbsup:
